people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.
translations.bsb: Because the Israelites are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt, they are not to be sold as slaves.
translations.kjv: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
translations.asv: For they are my servants, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
